title: Soul Feast # 5: Emotional Awareness – What It Is and How to Use It
excerpt: In today’s Soul Feast, Gary Zukav highlights the essential role of emotional awareness in our personal and spiritual growth.
bodyHtml:
In today’s Soul Feast, Gary Zukav highlights the essential role of emotional awareness in our personal and spiritual growth. 

He explains that emotions are messengers from the soul, guiding us to distinguish between fear and love.

By developing emotional awareness, we can discern between these two powerful forces and begin to create authentic power in our lives.

Gary touches on the concept of energy processing centers, or chakras, and how tuning into our bodies can help us understand what we are feeling and why. He introduces the idea of emotional literacy, which enables us to fully articulate our emotions and become more conscious of how fear or love influences our thoughts and actions.

As you listen, you’ll learn that living in the new consciousness requires emotional awareness, intention, and commitment.

By practicing emotional literacy and cultivating awareness of our chakras, we can better navigate our emotions and align with our soul’s purpose. 

Gary also encourages us to reflect on our emotional experiences, both painful and joyful, and to experiment with emotional awareness as a tool for creating authentic power.

What You’ll Discover in This Episode:

  • (02:00): What emotional awareness is and how it serves as a bridge to creating authentic power.
  • (08:05): How your emotions are messengers from the soul, revealing whether love or fear is driving you.
  • (13:03): The relationship between physical sensations, energy centers, and emotional experiences.
  • (21:00): Why emotional literacy is key to understanding your internal dynamics and becoming more aware of your soul’s guidance.

Your emotions are messages from your soul. Learn how to tune in and listen HERE.
